subject: POC Readout & Final Exec Review — Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jane Rogers <jane.rogers@acmehealth.com>, Daniel Lee <daniel.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC Readout & Final Exec Review — Acme Health

Hi Jane / Daniel —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Per our discussion, I pulled together the proposed success criteria and the evaluation plan for the POC so we can make the final readout and executive decision straightforward. See the attached "poc-success-criteria.xlsx" for the formal success matrix, but key items below: 

- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency <= 350ms for the priority inference route (500 token average).
- Throughput: Sustained throughput of 60 requests/minute during peak window with autoscaling in place.
- Quality: >90% accept rate on the canonical test prompts (we discussed the 30 prompt set).
- Security/Compliance: No egress of PHI; audit log visibility for all inference calls.

Evaluation plan & ownership:
- Redwood will run the POC on a dedicated pool for Acme (dedicated mode) and provide access to logs/dashboards.
- Acme to validate quality against the provided prompt set and log any A/B examples for triage (owner: Jane).
- Internal SRE/SE: Laura will own runtime tuning & support; Marcus will own contractual/price discussions.

Tentative timeline:
- POC execution window: 2026-03-08 -> 2026-03-20
- Final readout week: week of 2026-03-22
- Proposed exec review (go/no-go): 2026-03-24 (we can shift based on availability)
- Target for contract draft/SOW after go decision: by 2026-03-26

Next steps for your team: please confirm the success criteria above and the final readout attendees. If the timeline works, I can book a 30-minute executive readout and share an agenda (preview below).

Proposed final readout agenda (30m):
1) POC summary & metrics (Laura) — 10m
2) Key wins & outstanding gaps (Marissa) — 8m
3) Commercial next steps & timeline (Marcus) — 7m
4) Exec Q&A / go-no-go (Acme execs) — 5m

Attachment: poc-success-criteria.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to finalizing the schedule.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

- Ownership: I'll coordinate the evaluation and Daniel will handle procurement/commercial review. We also want to include our Head of Clinical Ops in the exec readout (likely the decision owner).
- Timing: 2026-03-24 at 10:00 AM ET works for us for the exec readout. Can your team do that slot?
